Dear Bieke,

I'm applying for the Sales Support Officer Benelux role at Edgard & Cooper. Your mission to make pet food good for pets and the planet, and your B Corp status, really resonate with me—especially as I've built a dog-care app myself. Dear Bieke,

I'm writing to apply for the Sales Support Officer Benelux role at Edgard & Cooper. Your mission to make pet food good for pets and the planet, and your B Corp status, really resonate with me—especially as I've built a dog-care app myself. I bring order to busy teams: at Episto I built ~600 member profile pages on one consistent layout, and for a kids' bike brand I ran a Google Ads test that achieved a 4.57% CTR and 53 clicks. I'm fluent in English and Dutch, and I have my own car, so the daily trip to your Kortrijk office is no problem.

In my current role as a Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I support client businesses with keyword research, technical SEO, and local SEO, and I track KPIs like rankings, traffic, and CTR in Semrush, Ahrefs, GA4, and Search Console. I also support a WooCommerce webshop with catalogue, product content, and conversion pages. As a freelancer, I sell AI search visibility, SEO, and marketing automation services, and I brought in a construction company through a referral, led the discovery meeting, and built a full growth proposal. These experiences have taught me to handle customer requests, manage sales administration, and keep commercial data accurate—skills that are directly relevant to supporting your Key Account Managers and Field Sales teams.

I'm organised, detail-focused, and proactive, with a practical approach to juggling priorities. I enjoy finding smarter ways to automate recurring tasks and simplify processes, which I believe will help your teams focus more on customers. I'm a collaborative team player who enjoys working across departments, and I'm confident with sales data, KPIs, and Microsoft Office, especially Excel.

In the first weeks, I would familiarise myself with your CRM and GS1 systems, build relationships with the KAMs and Field Sales teams, and start streamlining promotional follow-up and reporting. I'd welcome the chance to discuss how I can contribute to Edgard & Cooper's success.

Best regards,
Baver Ok

# Baver Ok
Sales support · KPI reporting · Google Ads · Dutch B1/A2+ · Excel
Zwijndrecht, Belgium | [+32 470 42 48 36](tel:+32470424836) | [baverok@gmail.com](mailto:baverok@gmail.com)
[linkedin.com/in/baverok](https://www.linkedin.com/in/baverok) | [baverok.com](https://baverok.com) | 02-04-1994
English (fluent) · Turkish (native) · Dutch (writing B1, speaking A2+)

## SUMMARY
I bring a sales mindset to marketing: I judge work by the customers it brings in. At Episto I track KPIs like rankings, traffic and CTR in Semrush, Ahrefs, GA4 and Search Console and report on results, while supporting a WooCommerce webshop with catalogue, product content and conversion pages. As a freelancer I sell services, run discovery meetings and build proposals, and I ran a self-funded Google Ads test in Belgium and the Netherlands with a 4.57% CTR. Years as a tango instructor taught me to work with people daily, build trust and take ownership. I speak Dutch at B1/A2+ and want to keep commercial teams organised and moving.

## PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

### Junior Digital Marketer – Episto (Remote), 03/2026 – Present
- Track KPIs (rankings, traffic, CTR) in Semrush, Ahrefs, GA4 and Search Console and report on results
- Support a WooCommerce webshop ([proteinbox.com.tr](https://proteinbox.com.tr)) with catalogue, product content and conversion pages
- Run keyword research, local and mobile SEO and link building for consulting, auto and e-commerce clients
- **#4 on page 1** of Google Turkey for "PDKS" (access-control software), as part of the agency team
- **~600 member profile pages** built and launched on one consistent layout for a pharmacists' association

### Freelance Digital Marketer – [baverok.com](https://baverok.com), 09/2026 – Present
- **4.57% CTR and 53 clicks** from a self-funded Google Ads test in Belgium and the Netherlands for a kids' bike brand: built two Dutch landing pages, chose buyer-intent keywords and presented the results to their team
- Sell AI search visibility, SEO, website and marketing automation services, with a free site check as the first step in each sales conversation
- Brought in a construction company through a referral, led the discovery meeting and built a full growth proposal covering the website, Google Business Profile, regional Google Ads and social media

### Web & SEO Specialist – Knowledge Experts ([KXP](https://kxp.be)), 01/2024 – 02/2026
- Analysed SEO performance and reported results to clients with Search Console and Google Analytics
- Built [kxp.be](https://kxp.be) single-handedly: WordPress, on-page SEO, GEO for AI search, in English, Dutch and French
- Delivered client websites end to end, from site structure and content to social media integration
- **#3 on Google** for "Belgian chess prodigy" with [mirook.com](https://mirook.com), a young chess player's personal-brand site, through technical SEO audits and schema markup

## PROJECTS & PRODUCTS

### PupSmart – AI dog-care app on [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.momoco.pupsmart)
- Designed, built and launched an Android app with a potty predictor, a toxic-food scanner and AI health insights based on each dog's 7-day activity log
- Published it under my own label, MomoCo: free with ads, with premium AI features for subscribers

### AI job-search assistant
- Built an AI tool that collects job postings from VDAB, LinkedIn and EURES, scores each one for fit and drafts a tailored CV and cover letter, as a working example of marketing automation

## SKILLS
- **Growth & sales:** client discovery meetings, offers and proposals, lead generation, landing pages, A/B testing
- **SEO & marketing:** Google Ads Search, WooCommerce, SEO strategy, keyword research, on-page, technical, local and mobile SEO, link building, SEO audits, schema markup, AI search (GEO/AEO), content marketing
- **Data & tools:** GA4, Google Search Console, Semrush, Ahrefs, Microsoft Clarity, WordPress/Elementor, HTML/CSS, Odoo, Canva, Claude/ChatGPT

## EDUCATION
- Applied Computer Science (coursework) – Karel de Grote Hogeschool, Antwerp, 2022 – 2025
- Computer Science (coursework) – Celal Bayar University, Türkiye, 2012 – 2016

## CERTIFICATIONS

- [Semrush Academy – SEO Toolkit](https://static.semrush.com/academy/certificates/35c1af233e/baver-ok_25.pdf) (2026)
